===Cutting gems into bolt tips===
Cutting gems into bolt tips can be done during downtime before attaching them to bolts. This is usually less practical than buying finished bolt tips directly, but it can still be worthwhile when the gem-to-tip margin is favourable. The table below is shown on a per-tip basis to match the tipped-bolts table.
